senses: to put to shame, be ashamed, be disconcerted, be disappointed
to be ashamed, disconcerted, disappointed (by reason of)
(Hithpolel) to be ashamed before one another

strongs.def: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
strongs.kjv: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long
